title: Ireland's most capped players
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for the Republic of Ireland in full internationals, to the end of the 2026 World Cup.

notes.Tony Cascarino: Tony Cascarino is joint 11th with 88, just outside.
notes.Shane Long: Shane Long is joint 11th with 88, just outside.
notes.Seamus Coleman: Seamus Coleman had 81 at the end of the 2026 World Cup.

checks: Wikipedia's national team article (16 July 2026), its list of internationals (18 July 2026) and RSSSF (to 5 June 2026) agree on every figure. Transfermarkt has the same ten but differs by one cap for Staunton (103), McGeady (92) and Cascarino (89); the association figures used by Wikipedia and RSSSF are used, and none changes the ten.
